headline: Canada September Trade Surplus Widens to Four-Year High of $5.35B
summary: Canada's merchandise trade surplus widened to $5.35 billion in September, reaching a four-year high supported by increased gold and energy exports primarily destined for the United States.
why: Trade balance figures influence national currency valuations and provide insight into export demand across key commodity sectors.

impacts.name: Canadian Dollar
impacts.why: A widening trade surplus reflects strong export performance, supporting domestic currency fundamentals.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
